sentences.text: The present case has been listed today as it is an old/ targeted matter.

2. The present appeal has been filed by the Appellant against the Judgment on conviction dated 15.05.2004 and order on sentence dated 21.05.2004 in FIR No.411/1999, registered at Police Station Sarai Rohilla for the offence punishable under Sections 302/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The appeal was admitted on 28.05.2004 and vide order dated 22.03.2005, the sentence of the Appellant was suspended during the pendency of the Appeal.
3. Today, there is no appearance on behalf of the Appellant.

4. Let Court Notice be issued to the Appellant, learned Counsel for the Appellant as well as to the Sureties, informing them about the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
